format: single Massage Envy Business (leased, 2,300-2,800 sq ft, high-end retail center)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Massage Envy Business ranges from $695,870 to $1,046,506. This includes an initial franchise fee of $45,000 that must be paid to ME SPE Franchising, LLC.

fee.quote: We currently charge an initial franchise fee of $45,000 for the right to operate a Massage Envy Business. If this is your second or subsequent Massage Envy franchise, your initial franchise fee for the new Massage Envy Business will be reduced to $35,000.
fee.note: Second or subsequent franchise $35,000. VetFran: veterans pay $36,000 for the first franchise ($9,000 discount) and $28,000 for a subsequent one. The Item 7 low total uses the $28,000 fee.

royalty.quote: Royalty 6% of Gross Sales Due on the day of each week we specify Based on Gross Sales during the previous week

adFund.quote: National Advertising Fund 2% of Gross Sales Due on the day of each week we specify ... Supplemental Marketing Fund 2% of Gross Sales ... This is an optional contribution.
adFund.note: National Advertising Fund 2% required. Supplemental Marketing Fund 2% optional, but franchisees not contributing to it may have to contribute to a Regional Advertising Cooperative (amount set by members). Grand opening advertising $15,000.

otherRecurring.name: P4 Technology Fees
otherRecurring.amount: approximately $705 per month if the Business has cable-enabled internet (Meevo Software $215 monthly; Internet/Managed Network/Security $367 per month; App Development & Maintenance $122.50 per month)

otherRecurring.name: Rapid Response/D3
otherRecurring.amount: Approximately $90 per month, but could increase if our costs increase

otherRecurring.name: NASF Employment Verification System
otherRecurring.amount: $150 Annually as incurred (currently paid by franchisor until October 2026)

transferFee.amount: 2/3 of our then-current initial franchise fee ... reduced transfer fee of between $500-$2,500 for an assignment to a wholly-owned entity or reallocation among existing owners

special: Initial Opening Package ($32,100 to $74,600) and build-out materials ($45,000 to $89,000) must be bought from designated suppliers, which pay the franchisor referral fees. Meevo and Centralized Tech fees continue after termination until memberships are transferred or funded. System shrinking: 1,083 to 993 outlets 2023-2025.
issues: Transfer fee printed only as 2/3 of the then-current initial franchise fee (no dollar figure), so usd null. Centralized Tech fee frequency inferred as monthly from the due date wording.
